# S185 — Decisions tab: answer an adj record with number keys and a confirmation

**Findings:**  · **Size:** S · **Tree:**

**2026-10-29** — **2026-10-29** — Split from S172 (owner, 2026-10-29). Runs after S172; waits on adj 173 (scope.v1-ork-edits, open). No TUI ask form; no reject, supersede or withdraw.

trust: unverified; by: Jon R

**Not in this slice:**

## Why

Split from S172 on 2026-10-29. This is the TUI half of the "Answer and ask adj records in ork" gap (parity rows 6.2 and 4.3; gap 7 of `docs/orchestrator-parity.md`). S172 adds the adjcli functions, the engine `AnswerRecord`, the daemon method `adj.answer` and `ork adj answer`; this slice lets the owner answer an open record from the TUI. It depends on S172, and so on adj `scope.v1-ork-edits` (adj 173, open): do not start until the owner has decided it.

Today the record pane of the Questions and Decisions views is read-only and reads the snapshot (`internal/tui/decisions.go:216-248`; `m.decisionPane`, `internal/tui/questions.go:67-81`). Digits there jump to a project. `docs/dashboard.md:1018-1019` says "An adj answer path is outside this view's current scope".

Owner decisions 2026-10-29:
- ork answers an adj record with `adj decide --by <owner> --why <text that cites ork, the surface and the date>`, and only for an option or a typed answer the owner gave in a prompt that names it. ork never runs `adj reject`, `adj supersede` or `adj withdraw` (`process.owner-answers`, #170; `AGENTS.md`, Decisions). The TUI has no key for any of them.
- There is no TUI form to ask a new record; `ork adj ask` (S172) is the only way.
- The answer always goes through a confirmation that names the record, the option and the owner's name. There is no key that skips it.

What this slice adds (all *proposed* until an adj record decides it): in an open record's detail pane (Questions view, Decisions Open tab), `1`-`4` pick that option and `t` types a free answer. Both end in the confirmation bar `Decide #12 as "label" in adj as NAME? [y/N] (Enter is No)`. `y` sends `adj.answer` with `Via` `tui`. Without `ADJ_DECIDED_BY` the keys say so and send nothing. A decided record shows no answer keys. Opening a record is still local; answering is the one write.

Facts: the owner's name comes from the caller's `ADJ_DECIDED_BY`, sent over the wire as `by` (`internal/tui/model.go:1391`). `docs/boundaries.md:70-73`: `adj decide` runs only on an explicit owner action, as the owner.

Not in this slice: the adjcli, engine and daemon code and the CLI commands (S172), a TUI form to ask a new record, `amend`, `withdraw`, `reject` and `supersede`, answering a record of a project that does not use adj.

Order: after S172. It shares `keys.go` and `model.go` with S170, S171 and S166 to S169; merge main before the gate. If S170 and S171 have landed, `decisionKey` is a sibling of `composeKey`, not a replacement.

- `TestDecisionPaneNumberKeyConfirmsThenDecides` (`internal/tui/decisionanswer_test.go`): in an open record's pane `2` opens the confirmation naming record, label and name; `n` and Enter cancel with no write; `y` calls `AdjAnswer` once with `Via` `tui` and `By` from `ADJ_DECIDED_BY`, closes the pane, says `decided in adj as #12` and fetches the project.
- `TestDecisionPaneFreeTextAndMissingDecidedBy`: `t` opens a text field (`+`, `-` and `q` type into it), `enter` leads to the same confirmation; with `ADJ_DECIDED_BY` unset every answer key says so and sends nothing.
- `TestDecisionPaneHintsFollowTheRecord`: the hint line lists `1-N pick` and `t free text` only for an open record in a project with adj and a daemon; a decided record, a pane in a project without adj, and a nil daemon list neither; `?` help names the keys.

## Implement

UI slice: UI pass (r14). It touches `internal/tui`, its golden views and `docs/dashboard.md`. Write the failing tests first.

1. `internal/tui/decisionanswer.go` (new): optional interface `adjAnswerer { AdjAnswer(ctx, daemon.AdjAnswerParams) (string, error) }` (as `laterFiler`, `findings.go:18-22`) and `Daemon.AdjAnswer` (`daemon.go:207-215` shows the shape; it calls S172's `Client.AdjAnswer`). `decisionKey(msg)` runs from `Model.key` before the generic switch (`model.go:482-540`) when `m.decisionPane != nil` and the record is open: `1`-`N` (N = number of options, at most 4) build a `runAction{verb: "decide"}` with the label and record id and set `m.confirm`; `t` opens a `textField`; `enter` there builds the same action from the typed text. Reuse the confirm flow (`model.go:507-521`). Extend `runAction` (`model.go:1120-1138`) with `adjID int` and `option string`; add `decide` to `command()` and `prompt()` (`model.go:1179-1230`: command `ork adj answer PROJECT ID --option "LABEL"`, then `Decide #ID as "LABEL" in adj as NAME? [y/N] (Enter is No)`), `confirmWord` (`keys.go:187-201`: `decide`), and `pendingText`/`doneText` (`card.go:591-654`). `callAction` (`model.go:1418-1470`) gets a `decide` case that calls `adjAnswerer` with `Via` `tui`; key the flight by `adj:PROJECT#ID`, not by run, and let the `actionMsg` handler (`model.go:360`) treat an empty run row as no run pane to update. `by` = `os.Getenv("ADJ_DECIDED_BY")`; blank means the key sets the status `ADJ_DECIDED_BY is unset; set it before answering in adj` and sends nothing. On success close the pane, set the status from the reply and `m.fetch(project, true)`. No key and no code path calls reject, supersede or withdraw.
2. `internal/tui/keys.go`: `PickAdj`/`FreeAdj` bindings or reuse `PickOption` and `FreeAnswer` with enabled checks; in the record-pane hint (`keys.go:321-329`) add `offer(answerable, ..., "1-N", "pick")` and `t free text`; `FullHelp` (`keys.go:122-131`) already lists them. The answerable check is one function used by the key and the hint (as `fileRefusal` is): open record, `reg.Adj`, daemon connected, `Live` has `adjAnswerer`. `projectTextEntry` (`projects.go:23-27`) is true while the free-text field is open. In `recordDetailLines` (`decisions.go:216-248`) number the option lines `1.` to `4.` only when the record is answerable, so the keys are visible.
